bundleSuggestion: Strong pairing with Story Masters, Writers Room, Storytelling Masterclass

cards.lore: The psychic economy of the character. The traits, the green shirt, the tan insignia — a delicate shell hiding the rot inside.
cards.power: Surface Tension. Deflect 1 attack using "Traits." Opponent must address your haircut instead of your core.

cards.lore: Why do you hold your hand like that? To set people at ease? Or to hide the shaking? Multiple humans use the same crutch.
cards.power: Subconscious Betrayal. Force opponent to reveal a card.

cards.lore: Honesty. Fidelity. Interconnection. The reason you can't have both the money and the girl.
cards.power: Value Nuke. Destroy all "Trait" cards in play.

cards.lore: Push them to the wall. Peel back the layers — the smiles, the costumes — until someone ends in tears.
cards.power: Tear Gas. All players skip 1 turn remembering Their "Glowing Core."

cards.lore: Man vs. Himself. The interior instability. Can you live with what you have to do? The fundamental drama of being alive.
cards.power: Self-Sabotage. Play on yourself to reroll a failed check.

cards.lore: Man vs. Man. My core value is Equality. Yours is Freedom. Now we have to vote. I can't believe who you are.
cards.power: Sociological Warfare. Force opponent to choose between 2 cards. They lose the unchosen one.

cards.lore: Man vs. The Elements. The world is indifferent to your "project." We thought we beat nature. We were wrong.
cards.power: Environmental Uprising. Wipe the board. Nature wins.

cards.lore: Honesty vs. Specificity. You can't have both. That specific agony? That's the generator for ten thousand stories.
cards.power: Cliché Storm. Nullify a unique effect by citing a trope.

cards.lore: You value the truth. Even if it bleeds your best friend dry. You have to own up to it.
cards.power: Brutal Truth. Deal double damage, but you must reveal your entire hand to the table.

cards.lore: I'm a good faithful friend. I'll support you no matter what. Even if you're wrong. Especially if you're wrong.
cards.power: Loyal Dog. Take damage for an ally. Sink with the ship.

cards.lore: Push them to the wall. Create a circumstance where they cannot have both values. Watch them squirm.
cards.power: Forced Choice. Opponent must discard their highest value card.

cards.lore: When push comes to shove, something falls by the wayside. You gotta jump. You gotta jump.
cards.power: Abandon Principles. Swap your hand with a discard.

cards.lore: I live in a house. Dirt. Wood. Stone. The meat and potatoes. No hiding behind fancy syllables.
cards.power: Blunt Force. Ignore defense. Words are short, hard, and old.

cards.lore: I reside in a mansion. Through the French court, we signal our socioeconomic register. Expensive words for expensive people.
cards.power: Class Privilege. Nullify a "Blunt Force" attack.

cards.lore: Yo. Give me that. Down and dirty. The signals of who you are and who you think I am.
cards.power: Yo! Interrupt an action immediately.

cards.lore: Will you please pass that? Sending signals to suppress the other person. Distance is a shield.
cards.power: Formal Distance. Players cannot attack you for 1 turn.

cards.lore: The heart and soul. The Predication. Everything else is just decoration. Strip it down.
cards.power: Unbreakable Core. Cannot be destroyed by "Adjective" cards.

cards.lore: He pointed the gun. Boom. Action first, consequence later. Put the shock at the front.
cards.power: Immediate Impact. Attack first in the round. No delay.

cards.lore: Way back, across the yard, near the fence, wait for it... wait for it... She hid.
cards.power: Withhold Subject. Opponent cannot act until the end of the turn.

cards.lore: Subject... [chaos/comedy/suspense]... Verb. The rarest form. A key change in the music.
cards.power: The Interrupt. Cancel an opponent's card as it is being played.

cards.lore: The Confederate dumps the pencils. If you read the story, you stop to help. Your baseline has shifted.
cards.power: Altruism Hack. Force opponent to help you (give you a card).

cards.lore: You hear it in your head. The author's voice becomes your voice. Possession by syntax.
cards.power: Voice in Head. Control opponent's next move.

cards.lore: Who would I be if I were not myself? The smallest appeal to affect makes people do things logic cannot.
cards.power: Forced Identification. Copy the power of the last played card.

cards.lore: I'm a moving target. The reader is a moving target. The world is moving. Give me a red pen.
cards.power: Edit History. Retcon a past turn.

cards.lore: Children know it's alive. Adults say "it's just wood." Recover the animism. Listen to the neighbors.
cards.power: Pantheism. Summon a "Nature" card from the deck.

cards.lore: Brains down there. Root plans. Making problems. Making decisions. We are not alone.
cards.power: Wood Wide Web. Look at everyone's hand.

cards.lore: Send out signals to wasps to save you from attack. The forest takes care of its own.
cards.power: Call the Cavalry. Deal damage equal to the number of cards in your hand.

cards.lore: Science and Spirit are commensal. Empirical backing for the poetic claim. Know the world both ways.
cards.power: Double Truth. Combine a "Science" card and a "Magic" card for double effect.

cards.lore: Not just a tree. An Ash. Diamond-shaped bark. Vivid and distinct.
cards.power: Specific Shield. Immune to generic attacks.

cards.lore: The Ironwood's fluted muscle. See the sinews. Projecting human power onto the wood.
cards.power: Botanical Strength. +2 to all Attack rolls.

cards.lore: The Maple's shower of helicopters. Weaponized seeds remembering the seasons of their childhood.
cards.power: Air Support. Attack any 1 player from any distance.

cards.lore: Rockets. Outlandish cars. Mastered areas. The architecture of an 8-year-old's boredom.
cards.power: Nostalgia Trip. Revert the game state to the previous turn.

cards.lore: Plowing in the dark. Remove the stimuli. Repurpose the sensory apparatus to see the invisible.
cards.power: Deprivation. Ignore all board effects for 1 turn.

cards.lore: The discipline. Get the words down. Stay there until it's done. A cage of your own making.
cards.power: Daily Quota. You must discard 3 cards to stay in the game.

cards.lore: Lying in bed. Covers up. Dictating to the ceiling. Recollecting in tranquility.
cards.power: Horizontal Productivity. Draw 2 cards while resting.

cards.lore: Give me another shot at that. You are never done. Slash it. Burn it. Make it effortless.
cards.power: Ruthless Edit. Remove a card from play permanently.

cards.lore: Language pulls the sled. Diction. Mastery. Syntax. The first dog in the line.
cards.power: Forward Momentum. Advance the game phase.

cards.lore: All the dogs in harness. Pulling in the same direction. If they pull apart, the story dies.
cards.power: Coherence. Link two cards together to share their stats.

cards.lore: The concern of crafting. The level granular to high level structure. It's heavy.
cards.power: Burden of Plot. Slow an opponent down.

cards.lore: Don't spend time telling the scene! Get them doing things! The tyranny of the writing prog[ram]...
cards.power: MFA Rule. Silence a player who talks too much.

cards.lore: Start high. Artificially high. Drop them in before they know what hit them.
cards.power: Artificial Tension. Force an opponent to engage with you.

cards.lore: Relax. Meet the cast. Bait and switch. Once they are oriented, we tighten the screws.
cards.power: Lull. Skip combat for 1 turn.

cards.lore: Every solution creates a larger instability. Up and up. Until you hit the wall.
cards.power: Escalation. Double the stakes of the current challenge.

cards.lore: The Knot blows apart. Release the tension. How is the world different now?
cards.power: Denouement. Resolve all active effects.

cards.lore: First there was nothing. Before the litres. Earn the right to tell the local story by starting with the universe.
cards.power: Cosmic Perspective. Ignore all "Local" effects.

cards.lore: Look harder. When you are close, look harder. Reality is moving. The detail is the god.
cards.power: Granularity. Focus damage on a single target.

cards.lore: The entire book is in a nutshell. Two houses both alike in dignity. The DNA of the drama.
cards.power: The Opener. Play this first to gain Initiative.

cards.lore: Each child's tree has its own... Excellence. Not the word you expected. Play off the AI model in the re[ader]...
cards.power: Surprise Ending. Swap the values of your Attack and Defense.

cards.lore: The loneliness of writing. Your brother says "interesting." They don't get it.
cards.power: Misunderstanding. Ignore a criticism/attack.

cards.lore: I'm studying forestry because of you. Days later — strangers while you sit in the dark.
cards.power: Remote Impact. Affect a player not adjacent to you.

cards.lore: Plunge back in. Test the products of solitude against the chaos. Get dirty.
cards.power: Re-Entry. Draw 3 cards but take damage.

cards.lore: Move in and out of orbit. If you stay solitary, you spin out. If you stay in the world, you disso[lve — text truncated].
cards.power: Orbit. Remove yourself from play for 1 turn.

cards.lore: Don't tell me you're angry. Show me the broken glass. (Also, shut up.)
cards.power: Silent Movie. Opponents cannot speak for 1 round.

cards.lore: The baroque, fluted, muscular, diamond-shaped, tempestuous verbiage. Too much flavor.
cards.power: Purple Prose. Confuse opponent. They miss their turn.

cards.lore: Wait, why did he do that? Who cares. The sled is moving.
cards.power: Logic Fail. Negate a rule for one turn.

cards.lore: God from the machine. When you can't untie the knot, just cut it.
cards.power: Lazy Fix. Win a tie automatically.

cards.lore: Draw your own Kayfabizarro Kards.
1. Print. 2. Cut. 3. Play. 4. Lie about the rules. 5. Stay Fluffy.
cards.power: Instruction.

cards.lore: Analog-first DIY cut & play artist. Epistemic sabotage. Layout anarchist.
cards.power: The Mascot. Use as a Wild Card.

cards.lore: Push them to the wall. Make them choose. If they don't cry, you aren't writing hard enough.
cards.power: The Objective. Push them to the wall. Make them choose. If they don't cry, you aren't writing hard enough.
